name: JCY International Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布涉及业务板块扩张、缩减、出售或新合约的公告；公告主要为附加上市公告、季度业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更等。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长62.3%至179,146,000 MYR，净利润为2,458,000 MYR。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts; announcements were mainly additional listing announcements, quarterly results, general meetings, and change of company secretary. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue grew 62.3% year-on-year to MYR 179,146,000, with net profit of MYR 2,458,000.
